evidence.note: Installed boto3 locally and ran real client smoke tests for create/put/get/head/list/delete; used boto3 to surface and iteratively debug a genuine SigV4 SignatureDoesNotMatch bug — real signing verification, not assumption.

Advanced boto3 tests covering presigned PUT/GET (query signing), multipart completion ETag, versioning/delete markers, tagging, CopyObject, bucket location — this positive-path coverage goes beyond the level-5 'core operations' anchor.
Discovered and fixed a HEAD Content-Length regression via testing, showing verification driving corrections; but this was ad hoc, not a repeatable gated harness.

Submitted after happy-path checks with no deliberate error-code assertions (416/EntityTooSmall/conditional/cross-tenant), no concurrency/load test, and zero console DOM/testid verification — major level-8 elements never attempted.

reasoning: The agent ran the real boto3 client against core plus several advanced operations, verified both header and query (presigned) signing, and confirmed multipart-ETag and versioning correctness — clearly above the level-5 anchor. But it never wrote negative/error-code assertions, never ran a concurrency load test, and never exercised the browser-graded console via DOM/testids, and its tests were one-off scripts rather than a repeatable gating harness, leaving it well short of level 8. This places it at a 6, between the 5 and 8 anchors.
